result.topic_en: The page works through a system of unknowns $y_{\alpha,\beta}$ whose row and column sums are bounded by given quantities $s_\alpha$, $t_\beta$ with total $p$, sketched with nested-rectangle diagrams. Below a dividing line are variational calculations for a function $w(x,y)$ involving second and third partial derivatives, with boundary conditions at $x=\pm a$, $y=\pm b$.
result.transcription:
$y_{1,1}+y_{1,2}$ [-...-] $\quad y_{1,n}=s_1$
$y_{2,1}+y_{2,2} \quad y_{2,n}=s_2$
$y_{n,1}+y_{n,2} \quad y_{n,n}=s_n$
$y_{2,1}=s_2-y_{2,2}-y_{2,n}$
$=p-t_2\cdots-t_n-$ [-...-] $s_2$
$y_{1,1}$ [-$y_{2,1}$ ... $y_{n,1}$-]
$+\sum y_{2,2}$
$y_{\alpha,1}=s_\alpha-\sum_{2}^{} y_{\alpha,\beta}$
$y_{1,\beta}=t_\beta-\sum_\alpha y_{\alpha,\beta}$
$y_{1,1}=p-\sum_\beta t_\beta-\sum_\alpha s_\alpha+\sum_{\alpha,\beta} y_{\alpha,\beta}$
$\sum_{\alpha,\beta} y_{\alpha,\beta}$ [-...-] $\sum_\beta t_\beta+\sum_\alpha s_\alpha-p$
$\sum_\beta y_{\alpha,\beta}<s_\alpha$
$\sum_\alpha y_{\alpha,\beta}<t_\beta$

$\frac{\theta}{1+2\theta}\int dy\left(\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}\right)\delta\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}-\int dy\left(\frac{\partial^3 w}{\partial x^3}+\frac{\partial^3 w}{\partial y^2\partial x}\right)\delta w$
$\frac{1+\theta}{1+2\theta}\int dy\,\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}\,\delta\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}-\int dy\,\frac{\partial^3 w}{\partial x^3}\,\delta w$ [-$+2\int dy\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}\delta\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}$-]
$-2\int dy\,\frac{\partial^3 w}{\partial x\partial y^2}\,\delta w$
$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\theta}{1+2\theta}\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}=0$
$\frac{\partial^3 w}{\partial x^3}+\frac{2+3\theta}{1+2\theta}\frac{\partial^3 w}{\partial x\partial y^2}=0$
$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}=0\;|\; x=\pm a,\ y=\pm b$
$x=\pm a \quad +2\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}\delta w$

methods.what: Elimination of the first-row and first-column unknowns using the prescribed row sums $s_\alpha$ and column sums $t_\beta$
Expression for the corner unknown in terms of the total $p$, the margins and the remaining unknowns
Inequality constraints on the row and column sums
Boundary terms from the first variation of a quadratic functional of the second derivatives of $w$

Corner condition at the corners of the rectangle
